questions.question_description: Implement insert, delete, and traverse operations on a normal Binary Tree (level order insertions).
questions.input_format: Integer N (number of operations), followed by N lines of 'insert X', 'delete X', or 'traverse'.
questions.output_format: For 'delete' if not found/supported, print 'Not Found'. For 'traverse', print space-separated inorder elements or 'Empty'.
questions.hints: Follow standard data structure logic for the tree type.

test_cases.input:
6
insert 1
insert 2
insert 3
delete 2
insert 4
traverse

8
insert 1
insert 2
insert 3
insert 4
insert 5
insert 6
delete 1
traverse

6
insert 10
insert 20
insert 30
delete 40
delete 20
traverse
